newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bund futures hit new contract high, eye 101.00.
newsitem.headline: Bund futures hit new contract high, eye 101.00.

text.p: German Bund futures continued their strong rise on Thursday, breaking the previous contract high and threatening the 101.00 level -- an advance that only a few weeks ago seemed out of the question.

Traders attributed Thursday's gains, which came without the usual help of U.S. Treasuries, to a reawakening of interest from domestic German investors who have plenty of buying power and want to jump on the rally bandwagon.
The December Bund future was up 34 basis points in late trade to 100.98, well above the previous contract high of 100.85 which had been set on Wednesday.
